activity_summary: Dinner was at the lodging. The loaf was a penny and a full thumb short of the notch, and you took the soft side because the jaw was quiet and not to be tried. You asked for a length of red thread in the evening, not the skein. Mistress Ansell told you to write the three lines home before you corrected the fair page again. The latch stays as it is.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the soft side, asked for a length of red, and promised the three lines before another correction.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Set the soft side toward him, stated the threepence and the sixpence, and refused the latch.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Showed the loaf against the notch and kept the crusts off his side.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Spoke once of a silk thread and a light, and left the table to the paper.
